title: Collinear Triples and Cubic Curves
exact_target: Must a planar point set with bounded line multiplicities and many pairs lying in collinear triples have a positive proportion of its points on one cubic curve?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 130 (GREEN-042). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author collection, Problem 69 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
